# Profile settings

## Sub-features

- Edit display name

## How to get to it

- Avatar menu → "Settings" → "Profile"
- URL: `/settings/profile`

## Driving it

1. Open `/settings/profile`.
2. Fill `#display-name`, then click `[data-testid="save-profile"]`.
3. Run `npm run dev` first (a command; not checked).

## Gotchas

- None known.

## Touches

- `src/app/settings/profile/**`
- `src/components/ProfileForm.tsx`
